measures.label: Children and youth under age 19 with Medicaid or other means-tested public health coverage (civilian noninstitutionalized population)
measures.note: American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates, table S2704. Medicaid/means-tested public coverage includes Medi-Cal and other means-tested public health coverage, alone or in combination with other coverage, as reported by survey respondents. The Census Bureau publishes this measure for the under 19 age group.
